title: Consultant, Digital Economy
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the Director, Digital Economy, Pan-African Program, the Consultant will provide senior-level strategic, technical and advisory support to strengthen the design, quality assurance and implementation oversight of the Pan-African (PANA) Digital Economy portfolio. The role will advance the Digital Economy enabling function across key Foundation thematic areas, including agrifood systems, entrepreneurship, climate resilience and other priority sectors, while helping shape enterprise-level thinking on Artificial Intelligence and its implications for youth employment, program design and systems change. Working directly with the Director, Digital Economy, the Consultant will go beyond strategy and advisory support to translate emerging opportunities into practical programs, partnerships and delivery models. The Consultant will play a key role in supporting the design and implementation of flagship Digital Economy initiatives, ensuring that technology, and Artificial Intelligence in particular, are applied in ways that enable dignified and fulfilling work opportunities for young Africans. This role requires a research-led practitioner who combines rigorous evidence and analysis with program design expertise and the ability to move concepts to implementation. Contract Duration: Six months. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Serve as a senior thought partner to the Director, Digital Economy on portfolio strategy, program quality, investment opportunities, and emerging risks across AI, platform economies, global business services, entrepreneurship and digital innovation in Africa. Lead the implementation-ready design of a flagship Pan-African AI initiative, including its program thesis, target populations, priority sectors and country pathways, partnership model, theory of change, budget, MEL framework, learning agenda and implementation roadmap. Provide technical and programmatic quality assurance for Digital Economy investments and partner proposals, including partner selection, program investment cases, approval materials and implementation oversight. Support country and thematic teams to responsibly integrate AI-enabled and digital economy approaches into program design and delivery where they can improve youth employment, productivity, income or livelihood outcomes. Strengthen the Foundation’s Digital Economy enabling function across agrifood systems, entrepreneurship, climate and other priority platforms by translating digital and AI trends into practical employment, livelihood and enterprise-development opportunities. Produce evidence reviews and landscape analyses on AI, the digital economy and youth livelihoods in Africa to inform the flagship AI initiative, portfolio design and investment decisions. Facilitate collaboration among public sector, private sector, academia and ecosystem actors, connecting technology opportunities to youth livelihood outcomes grounded in African labour markets and economic sectors. Document evidence, learning and reusable program-design approaches across the PANA portfolio. Prepare a monthly report summarizing key insights, risks, recommendations and priorities. WHO YOU ARE A PhD, or an equivalent record of peer-reviewed research in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, technology, agritech, economics, including development or agricultural economics, or a related field is preferred. Exceptional candidates with a master’s degree and a substantial body of published research focused on Africa or comparable emerging economies will also be considered. Relevant educational credentials combined with strong design, technical and program-delivery experience are a strong advantage. Minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, which may include doctoral or post-doctoral research, across the private, public, academic or non-profit sectors, including substantial experience in digital technology, skills development, enterprise productivity, livelihoods or work enablement in Africa. Experience working in or with African research and innovation institutions, such as national science councils, research foundations, universities or international research centres, particularly in translating research into programs, solutions, policy or investment decisions, is a strong advantage. A hands-on practitioner with a demonstrable track record of personally designing, informing or supporting the implementation of large-scale programs, partnerships, digital products or platforms that achieved measurable livelihood, productivity, income or employment outcomes. Practical understanding of responsible AI, data governance, digital inclusion and the ethical deployment of technology in African contexts. Practical experience working at the intersection of technology and economic development, with experience taking ideas from concept through design, partner engagement, implementation planning and launch. Research and/or delivery experience in Sub-Saharan Africa, applying digital technologies, data or AI within sectors such as agriculture, informal enterprise, manufacturing, financial inclusion or digital work. Strong understanding of African labour markets and youth employment challenges and opportunities. Experience working with technology companies, startups, digital platforms, innovation ecosystems or AI-enabled solutions. Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality analytical, technical and program-design outputs independently. High degree of professionalism and integrity, aligned with the Foundation’s values and commitment to quality. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. For more information and to sign up for the Foundation’s newsletter, please visit http://www.mastercardfdn.org/ Follow the Foundation on Twitter at MastercardFdn

title: Head of Strategy Delivery
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the Country Director, the Head of Strategy & Planning serves as a trusted strategic adviser and execution partner to the Country Director. The role leads the development, implementation, monitoring, and periodic review of the Ethiopia Country Program’s strategy and annual operating plans. It drives organizational performance, strategic alignment, cross-functional coordination, and operational rigour to enhance the quality and impact of programming. The role supports the Country Director in setting and managing leadership priorities, facilitating effective decision-making, coordinating the Country Leadership Team, and ensuring timely execution of critical decisions and strategic initiatives. The position also leads high-priority, cross-functional, and transformational projects while strengthening information flow, organizational accountability, and follow-through across the Country Program. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Strategy and Planning Lead the development, review, and implementation of the Ethiopia Country Program strategy; translate it into annual operating plans, priorities, targets, measurable outcomes, and short-, medium-, and long-term roadmaps. Coordinate planning across functions and align programmatic, operational, financial, and people priorities. Provide strategic analysis, research, scenarios, and recommendations; monitor the external environment and assess implications for the Country Program. Strategy Execution and Performance Management Establish and manage a framework for monitoring strategic priorities, Country Program performance, key results, and quarterly performance reviews. Track leadership decisions and strategic initiatives, escalate risks and delays, prepare concise reports, dashboards, and decision papers, and facilitate corrective action where performance is below target. Chief of Staff Support Serve as a trusted adviser and thought partner to the Country Director; help establish leadership priorities and manage the flow, prioritization, delegation, and escalation of strategic information and decisions. Prepare the Country Director for critical engagements; attend selected meetings with or on behalf of the Country Director; and ensure decisions and actions are documented and implemented. Leadership Governance and Coordination Coordinate the Country Leadership Team’s annual agenda, meetings, retreats, and strategic discussions, with a clear focus on decisions, priorities, performance, risks, and accountability. Maintain a consolidated record of leadership decisions, commitments, and actions; identify organizational bottlenecks; and strengthen communication and coordination across the Country Program. Strategic Initiatives and Transformation Lead high-priority, cross-functional, and transformational initiatives by establishing clear objectives, governance, milestones, resources, reporting mechanisms, and risk-mitigation actions. Ensure strategic projects achieve intended results within agreed timelines, while promoting innovation, organizational learning, and effective change management. Program Quality and Organizational Effectiveness Support leadership oversight of program quality, impact, and strategic alignment; facilitate portfolio reviews; identify systemic delivery challenges; and escalate major risks, interdependencies, and resource constraints for resolution. WHO YOU ARE A master’s degree in International Development, Public Policy, Economics, or another relevant field is preferred. Professional certification in strategy, project or programme management, change management, performance management, or organizational development is an added advantage; continuous professional development in strategic leadership, executive advisory, or organizational performance is desirable. Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible professional experience, including at least five years in a senior strategy, planning, management consulting, programme leadership, executive advisory, or general management role. Demonstrated experience leading strategy development, annual planning, execution, performance reviews, and the translation of strategy into practical priorities, indicators, and accountability mechanisms. Experience serving as a strategic adviser or thought partner to a Chief Executive, Country Director, senior executive, or leadership team. Proven ability to lead complex, high-profile, cross-functional initiatives from conception through implementation and evaluation. Experience coordinating leadership forums, management reviews, strategic retreats, and executive decision-making processes, and producing high-quality briefings, analyses, business cases, presentations, reports, and decision papers. Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, organizational performance monitoring, financial planning, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, and corrective action. Experience working in complex, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, preferably within international development, philanthropy, the public sector, consulting, or another mission-driven organization. Significant knowledge of Ethiopia’s development context, with broader exposure to social and economic development issues in Africa, is highly desirable. Demonstrates strategic thinking and systems analysis, strategy development and planning, strategy execution and performance management, data analysis and management reporting, executive advisory and decision support, programme, project, and governance management, financial, operational, and risk management, and strategic communication and stakeholder influence. Demonstrates strategic leadership and results orientation, sound judgment, adaptability, and problem-solving, influence, collaboration, and clear communication, inclusive people leadership and teamwork, and integrity, discretion, fairness, respect, humility, and responsible leadership. Strong commitment to Mastercard Foundation’s values and vision. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. For more information and to sign up for the Foundation’s newsletter, please visit http://www.mastercardfdn.org/ Follow the Foundation on Twitter at MastercardFdn
